# =============================================================================
# Yggdrasil — JSX Transpiler
# Compiler: clang++ (C++17)
# =============================================================================

CXX      := clang++
CXXFLAGS := -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Iinclude
LDFLAGS  :=

# Directories
SRC_DIR   := src
INC_DIR   := include
BUILD_DIR := build
BIN_DIR   := bin

TARGET := $(BIN_DIR)/yggdrasil

# Collect all .cpp sources
SRCS := $(wildcard $(SRC_DIR)/*.cpp)
OBJS := $(patsubst $(SRC_DIR)/%.cpp,$(BUILD_DIR)/%.o,$(SRCS))

# Header dependencies (all headers in include/)
HEADERS := $(wildcard $(INC_DIR)/*.h)

# =============================================================================
# Targets
# =============================================================================

.PHONY: all clean release debug test help

all: $(TARGET)

# Link
$(TARGET): $(OBJS) | $(BIN_DIR)
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) $(LDFLAGS) -o $@ $^
	@echo "Built: $@"

# Compile each .cpp → .o
$(BUILD_DIR)/%.o: $(SRC_DIR)/%.cpp $(HEADERS) | $(BUILD_DIR)
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -c -o $@ $<

# Create output directories
$(BUILD_DIR):
	mkdir -p $(BUILD_DIR)

$(BIN_DIR):
	mkdir -p $(BIN_DIR)

# Debug build (no optimisation, debug symbols, sanitisers)
debug: CXXFLAGS += -g -O0 -DDEBUG -fsanitize=address,undefined
debug: LDFLAGS  += -fsanitize=address,undefined
debug: $(TARGET)

# Release build (optimised, strip debug info)
release: CXXFLAGS += -O2 -DNDEBUG
release: $(TARGET)

# Run test fixtures
test: $(TARGET)
	@echo "=== Running test fixtures ==="
	@pass=0; fail=0; \
	for jsx in tests/fixtures/*.jsx; do \
		base=$${jsx%.jsx}; \
		expected=$${base}.expected.js; \
		if [ ! -f "$$expected" ]; then continue; fi; \
		actual=$$($(TARGET) "$$jsx" 2>&1); \
		if [ "$$actual" = "$$(cat $$expected)" ]; then \
			echo "  PASS: $$jsx"; pass=$$((pass+1)); \
		else \
			echo "  FAIL: $$jsx"; \
			echo "  --- expected ---"; cat "$$expected"; \
			echo "  --- actual ---";  echo "$$actual"; \
			fail=$$((fail+1)); \
		fi; \
	done; \
	echo "Results: $$pass passed, $$fail failed"

clean:
	rm -rf $(BUILD_DIR) $(BIN_DIR)

help:
	@echo "Targets:"
	@echo "  all      Build the transpiler (default)"
	@echo "  debug    Build with debug symbols and sanitisers"
	@echo "  release  Build optimised"
	@echo "  test     Run fixture tests"
	@echo "  clean    Remove build artefacts"

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Build script for Yggdrasil JSX Transpiler (Windows / PowerShell).

.DESCRIPTION
    Wraps clang++ invocations for developers who prefer PowerShell over make.
    Supports Debug, Release, and Test modes.

.PARAMETER Mode
    Build mode: Debug | Release | Clean | Test (default: Debug)

.PARAMETER Run
    After a successful build, run the transpiler with these arguments.
    Example: .\build.ps1 -Run "tests\fixtures\basic.jsx"

.EXAMPLE
    .\build.ps1
    .\build.ps1 -Mode Release
    .\build.ps1 -Mode Test
    .\build.ps1 -Mode Debug -Run "tests\fixtures\basic.jsx"
#>

param(
    [ValidateSet("Debug","Release","Clean","Test")]
    [string]$Mode = "Debug",

    [string]$Run = ""
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Paths
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$Root      = $PSScriptRoot
$SrcDir    = Join-Path $Root "src"
$IncDir    = Join-Path $Root "include"
$BuildDir  = Join-Path $Root "build"
$BinDir    = Join-Path $Root "bin"
$Target    = Join-Path $BinDir "yggdrasil.exe"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Compiler settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$CXX       = "clang++"
$BaseFlags = @("-std=c++17", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Wpedantic", "-I$IncDir")

$ModeFlags = switch ($Mode) {
    "Debug"   { @("-g", "-O0", "-DDEBUG", "-fsanitize=address,undefined") }
    "Release" { @("-O2", "-DNDEBUG") }
    default   { @() }
}

$CXXFlags = $BaseFlags + $ModeFlags

$LDFlags = if ($Mode -eq "Debug") {
    @("-fsanitize=address,undefined")
} else {
    @()
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Invoke-Checked {
    param([string]$Exe, [string[]]$Args)
    Write-Host "> $Exe $($Args -join ' ')" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
    & $Exe @Args
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Write-Error "Command failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE"
    }
}

function Get-Sources {
    Get-ChildItem -Path $SrcDir -Filter "*.cpp" | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Clean
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ($Mode -eq "Clean") {
    Write-Host "Cleaning build artefacts..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    if (Test-Path $BuildDir) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $BuildDir }
    if (Test-Path $BinDir)   { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $BinDir   }
    Write-Host "Done." -ForegroundColor Green
    exit 0
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test (run fixture tests without rebuilding if binary exists)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ($Mode -eq "Test") {
    if (-not (Test-Path $Target)) {
        Write-Host "Binary not found — building first (Debug)..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        & $PSCommandPath -Mode Debug
    }
    Write-Host "=== Running fixture tests ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    $pass = 0; $fail = 0
    $fixtures = Get-ChildItem -Path (Join-Path $Root "tests\fixtures") -Filter "*.jsx" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    foreach ($jsx in $fixtures) {
        $expectedPath = [IO.Path]::ChangeExtension($jsx.FullName, ".expected.js")
        if (-not (Test-Path $expectedPath)) { continue }
        $actual   = & $Target $jsx.FullName 2>&1 | Out-String
        $expected = Get-Content $expectedPath -Raw
        if ($actual.TrimEnd() -eq $expected.TrimEnd()) {
            Write-Host "  PASS: $($jsx.Name)" -ForegroundColor Green
            $pass++
        } else {
            Write-Host "  FAIL: $($jsx.Name)" -ForegroundColor Red
            Write-Host "  -- expected --" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow
            Write-Host $expected
            Write-Host "  -- actual --" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow
            Write-Host $actual
            $fail++
        }
    }
    Write-Host "Results: $pass passed, $fail failed" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    exit ($fail -gt 0 ? 1 : 0)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $BuildDir | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $BinDir   | Out-Null

$sources = Get-Sources
$objects = @()

Write-Host "=== Compiling ($Mode) ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan

foreach ($src in $sources) {
    $name = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($src)
    $obj  = Join-Path $BuildDir "$name.o"
    $objects += $obj
    Invoke-Checked $CXX ($CXXFlags + @("-c", "-o", $obj, $src))
}

Write-Host "=== Linking ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Invoke-Checked $CXX ($CXXFlags + $LDFlags + @("-o", $Target) + $objects)

Write-Host "Built: $Target" -ForegroundColor Green

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Optional: run after build
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ($Run -ne "") {
    Write-Host "=== Running ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Invoke-Checked $Target @($Run)
}

arguments.content:
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Fixture test runner for Yggdrasil.

.DESCRIPTION
    Two fixture conventions are supported:
      *.jsx + *.expected.js   — transpiler output must equal the .expected.js file
      *.jsx + *.expected_exit — transpiler must exit with the code in that file (error tests)

.PARAMETER Binary
    Path to the yggdrasil binary. Defaults to bin\yggdrasil.exe relative to repo root.

.PARAMETER Filter
    Optional glob filter on fixture base names, e.g. "01_*" or "err_*".
#>
param(
    [string]$Binary = "",
    [string]$Filter = "*"
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$RepoRoot    = Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "..\..") | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Path
$FixturesDir = Join-Path $RepoRoot "tests\fixtures"

if ($Binary -eq "") {
    $Binary = Join-Path $RepoRoot "bin\yggdrasil.exe"
}

if (-not (Test-Path $Binary)) {
    Write-Error "Binary not found: $Binary`nBuild first with: .\build.ps1"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ANSI colour helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Green  { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Green  -NoNewline }
function Red    { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Red    -NoNewline }
function Yellow { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Yellow -NoNewline }
function Cyan   { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Cyan   -NoNewline }
function Nl     { Write-Host "" }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Diff helper — show first divergence
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Show-Diff {
    param([string]$Expected, [string]$Actual)
    $expLines = $Expected -split "`n"
    $actLines = $Actual   -split "`n"
    $max = [Math]::Max($expLines.Count, $actLines.Count)
    $shown = 0
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $max -and $shown -lt 8; $i++) {
        $e = if ($i -lt $expLines.Count) { $expLines[$i] } else { "<missing>" }
        $a = if ($i -lt $actLines.Count) { $actLines[$i] } else { "<missing>" }
        if ($e -ne $a) {
            Yellow "    line $($i+1):`n"; Nl
            Green  "      expected: $e"; Nl
            Red    "      actual  : $a"; Nl
            $shown++
        }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Collect fixtures
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$jsxFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $FixturesDir -Filter "$Filter.jsx" |
            Where-Object { $_.Name -notmatch "^err_" -or $_.Name -match "^err_" } |
            Sort-Object Name

$pass = 0
$fail = 0
$skip = 0

Write-Host ""
Cyan "=== Yggdrasil Fixture Tests ==="; Nl
Write-Host "  Binary  : $Binary"
Write-Host "  Fixtures: $FixturesDir"
Write-Host "  Filter  : $Filter"
Write-Host ""

foreach ($jsx in $jsxFiles) {
    $base        = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($jsx.FullName)
    $expectedJs  = Join-Path $FixturesDir "$base.expected.js"
    $expectedExit= Join-Path $FixturesDir "$base.expected_exit"

    # ---- Error-exit test ----
    if (Test-Path $expectedExit) {
        $wantExit = (Get-Content $expectedExit -Raw).Trim()
        $output   = & $Binary $jsx.FullName 2>&1
        $gotExit  = $LASTEXITCODE
        if ([string]$gotExit -eq $wantExit) {
            Green "  PASS"; Write-Host " [exit=$gotExit] $($jsx.Name)"
            $pass++
        } else {
            Red   "  FAIL"; Write-Host " [exit=$gotExit, want=$wantExit] $($jsx.Name)"
            $fail++
        }
        continue
    }

    # ---- Output comparison test ----
    if (-not (Test-Path $expectedJs)) {
        Yellow "  SKIP"; Write-Host " (no .expected.js) $($jsx.Name)"
        $skip++
        continue
    }

    $expected = (Get-Content $expectedJs -Raw).TrimEnd()
    $actual   = (& $Binary $jsx.FullName 2>&1 | Out-String).TrimEnd()
    $exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE

    if ($exitCode -ne 0) {
        Red   "  FAIL"; Write-Host " [exit=$exitCode] $($jsx.Name)"
        Write-Host "    stderr: $actual"
        $fail++
        continue
    }

    if ($actual -eq $expected) {
        Green "  PASS"; Write-Host " $($jsx.Name)"
        $pass++
    } else {
        Red   "  FAIL"; Write-Host " $($jsx.Name)"
        Show-Diff $expected $actual
        $fail++
    }
}

Write-Host ""
Cyan "Results: "; Nl
Green  "  $pass passed"; Nl
if ($fail -gt 0)  { Red    "  $fail failed"; Nl }
if ($skip -gt 0)  { Yellow "  $skip skipped"; Nl }
Write-Host ""

exit ($fail -gt 0 ? 1 : 0)

arguments.content:
# =============================================================================
# Yggdrasil — JSX Transpiler
# Compiler: clang++ (C++17)
# Cross-platform: Windows (cmd/nmake-style) and Unix (bash)
# =============================================================================

CXX      := clang++
CXXFLAGS := -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Iinclude
LDFLAGS  :=

# Directories
SRC_DIR   := src
INC_DIR   := include
BUILD_DIR := build
BIN_DIR   := bin

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# OS detection
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ifeq ($(OS),Windows_NT)
    PLATFORM      := windows
    TARGET        := $(BIN_DIR)/yggdrasil.exe
    RM_RF         := rmdir /s /q
    MKDIR         = if not exist "$@" mkdir "$@"
    DEVNULL       := nul
    # PowerShell available everywhere on modern Windows
    TEST_CMD      := powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass \
                     -File tests\runner\run_tests.ps1 -Binary $(TARGET)
    PATHSEP       := \\
else
    UNAME := $(shell uname -s)
    PLATFORM      := unix
    TARGET        := $(BIN_DIR)/yggdrasil
    RM_RF         := rm -rf
    MKDIR         = mkdir -p "$@"
    DEVNULL       := /dev/null
    TEST_CMD       = @pass=0; fail=0; \
        for jsx in tests/fixtures/*.jsx; do \
            base=$${jsx%.jsx}; \
            expected=$${base}.expected.js; \
            [ -f "$$expected" ] || continue; \
            actual=$$($(TARGET) "$$jsx" 2>&1); \
            exp=$$(cat "$$expected"); \
            if [ "$$actual" = "$$exp" ]; then \
                printf '  \033[32mPASS\033[0m %s\n' "$$jsx"; pass=$$((pass+1)); \
            else \
                printf '  \033[31mFAIL\033[0m %s\n' "$$jsx"; \
                printf '  --- expected ---\n'; echo "$$exp"; \
                printf '  --- actual   ---\n'; echo "$$actual"; \
                fail=$$((fail+1)); \
            fi; \
        done; \
        printf 'Results: %d passed, %d failed\n' "$$pass" "$$fail"; \
        [ $$fail -eq 0 ]
    PATHSEP       := /
endif

# Collect all .cpp sources
SRCS := $(wildcard $(SRC_DIR)/*.cpp)
OBJS := $(patsubst $(SRC_DIR)/%.cpp,$(BUILD_DIR)/%.o,$(SRCS))

# Header dependencies (all headers in include/)
HEADERS := $(wildcard $(INC_DIR)/*.h)

# =============================================================================
# Targets
# =============================================================================

.PHONY: all clean release debug test help

all: $(TARGET)

# Link
$(TARGET): $(OBJS) | $(BIN_DIR)
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) $(LDFLAGS) -o $@ $^
	@echo "Built: $@"

# Compile each .cpp -> .o
$(BUILD_DIR)/%.o: $(SRC_DIR)/%.cpp $(HEADERS) | $(BUILD_DIR)
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -c -o $@ $<

# Create output directories
$(BUILD_DIR):
	$(MKDIR)

$(BIN_DIR):
	$(MKDIR)

# Debug build (no optimisation, debug symbols, sanitisers)
debug: CXXFLAGS += -g -O0 -DDEBUG -fsanitize=address,undefined
debug: LDFLAGS  += -fsanitize=address,undefined
debug: $(TARGET)

# Release build (optimised)
release: CXXFLAGS += -O2 -DNDEBUG
release: $(TARGET)

# Run test fixtures
test: $(TARGET)
	$(TEST_CMD)

# Clean build artefacts
clean:
ifeq ($(PLATFORM),windows)
	-$(RM_RF) $(BUILD_DIR) 2>$(DEVNULL)
	-$(RM_RF) $(BIN_DIR)   2>$(DEVNULL)
else
	$(RM_RF) $(BUILD_DIR) $(BIN_DIR)
endif

help:
	@echo "Targets:"
	@echo "  all      Build the transpiler (default)"
	@echo "  debug    Build with debug symbols and sanitisers"
	@echo "  release  Build optimised"
	@echo "  test     Run fixture tests"

MVP Stage 2 — "Solid Tool"
After your basic transpiler works on single files, Stage 2 is about making it robust, usable, and fast without turning it into Babel.
1. Error Recovery & Diagnostics

    Don't crash on first error — resynchronize and report multiple errors per file
    Track source locations in AST nodes (line/column) for precise error pointing even without source maps
    Contextual error messages — "Expected > but found } — did you forget to close an attribute?"

2. Complete JSX Spec Coverage

    Member expression tags: <My.Component />, <context.Provider />
    Namespace tags: <svg:circle /> (if you care about SVG/mathML)
    Spread children: {...items} (rare but valid)
    Whitespace normalization in JSXText — collapse rules differ from HTML
    Comments inside JSX: {/* this */} properly stripped or preserved
    Boolean attributes: <input disabled /> → disabled: true

3. Configurable Output (via config.json or cmdline args)

    Pragma switching: React.createElement vs h() (Preact) vs _jsx (React 17+ automatic runtime)
    Development vs production flags: __source and __self props for React dev warnings
    JSX runtime import injection (React 17+ style: import { jsx } from 'react/jsx-runtime')

4. Performance & Architecture

    Arena allocator for AST nodes instead of individual new/delete or heavy smart pointer churn
    Zero-copy lexer — slice strings from source buffer instead of allocating
    Streaming/batch mode — transpile entire directories, not just stdin/single file
    CLI with flags: --pragma, --out-dir, --watch

5. Edge Case Hardening

    Unicode identifiers in tag names and attributes
    Complex expressions in attributes: <div attr={foo.bar[baz]()} />
    Nested ternaries with JSX: cond ? <A /> : <B /> (parser precedence handling)
    Adjacent JSX elements in expressions: (<></>) fragments wrapping siblings

+2–3 weeks on top of MVP.
